todo.objective: A personal to-do list mobile app where a user can create, edit, complete and organize tasks, with data persisting across app launches.

capabilities.reason: build and ship the app UI and interactions on iOS
persist tasks locally so they survive relaunches and stay consistent

screws.objective: Build a machine that dispenses screws one at a time, counts them as they pass, and syncs inventory counts to an online database of parts on hand.

capabilities.reason: must mechanically separate and dispense one screw at a time from a bulk hopper
needs to confirm/count screws dispensed, likely via weight or sensor counting
alternative/complementary way to count screws passing a chute using a camera
microcontroller firmware to run the dispenser mechanism and sensors
device needs to talk to a server to update the online parts database
backend API needed to store and serve the parts inventory database
parts inventory data needs a normalized schema to track quantities and part types

rc-truck.clarifying_question: Do you want to build/modify an actual RC truck (chassis, electronics), or something else like a model/render of one?

knob.objective: Build a single rotary knob device whose feel (detents, friction, spring endstops) is software-programmable, using a motorized/encoded knob mechanism to render haptic feedback for different modes.

capabilities.reason: must read absolute knob rotary position precisely to render haptics
core feature: designing and tuning detent/spring/friction feel profiles
knob needs closed-loop torque control from a motor to generate programmable resistance/detents
torque/position control loop must be tuned against encoder feedback for stable haptic response
firmware needed to run control loop, store profiles, and expose programmability
custom board needed to combine motor driver, encoder and MCU
knob housing and mechanical assembly need to be modeled and printed

coaster.objective: Build a smart coaster with an embedded load cell and PCB that senses drink weight/level and reports or displays it.

capabilities.reason: sense drink weight via a load cell and convert to usable readings
design schematic for the coaster's sensing and MCU circuit
route a compact round PCB that fits inside a coaster form factor
assemble the small SMD components on the coaster PCB
write firmware to read the load cell and process weight data
design battery power for a small low-profile coaster device

birds.objective: Create an illustration of a row of birds standing lined up along a beach shoreline, using traditional or digital drawing techniques with correct perspective and composition.

capabilities.reason: requires drawing birds and a beach scene with correct anatomy, perspective and composition

printed.clarifying_question: What object do you want to 3D print?

keep Apothecary Diaries characters recognizable and consistent across multiple generated images

apothecary.objective: Generate AI fan art of characters from the anime/manga 'The Apothecary Diaries' in a consistent, on-model style.

fishtank.objective: A short Blender animation depicting the point of view of a fish looking out through a fishtank into a Chinese restaurant scene, rendered as a finished cinematic clip.

capabilities.reason: model the fishtank, water, fish, and restaurant interior props
build glass, water and lit restaurant materials with believable refraction and lighting
block and animate the POV camera looking out through the curved tank glass
animate the fish and restaurant patrons with believable motion and timing
render passes and composite the underwater-to-room look with color grading
simulate water surface/caustics inside the tank for realism
need a cel-shaded look that reads as 90s anime style
need a clean character/scene mesh to shade and animate
character needs an armature and controls to pose/animate
shot requires timing and weight that reads as anime-style motion
need a camera blocked and animated to sell the shot
final look needs render passes and color grading typical of the anime aesthetic

anime90s.objective: Create a short animated scene in Blender styled to look like 90s cel-shaded anime, featuring a character shot with stylized lighting and motion.

gacha.objective: A mobile game where players cook dishes with anime-style character companions ("waifus") who are collected via a gacha system, progressing through recipes and character bonds.

capabilities.reason: core game state machine covering menus, cooking gameplay, and gacha flow
drop rates, pity system and character progression for the gacha mechanic
touch UI for cooking minigame, gacha pulls, and character screens
must persist collected characters, currency and cooking progress across sessions
waifu characters need consistent visual design across many art assets
character and food art needs solid drawing fundamentals

golf-mount.objective: A 3D-printed mount that clamps onto a golf bag and holds an iPhone at an angle suitable for filming a golf swing.

capabilities.reason: Mount must clamp securely to the measured tube diameter of a golf bag strap/frame
Model the mount body and phone cradle parametrically in CAD
Mount must hold the iPhone rigid while the bag is carried or bounced on a cart, without blurring video
Filament and print orientation must handle outdoor sun, heat and impact resistance
Mount needs a clip/latch mechanism to hold and release the phone without extra fasteners

pokemon-bin.objective: A 3D-printed modular storage system for bulk Pokemon cards, with bins or dividers color-coded by energy type for sorting and organizing large collections.

capabilities.reason: model bins/dividers sized to standard card dimensions and bulk stack heights
ensure cards and dividers fit snugly within printed slots without binding
stackable or interlocking bins for modular bulk storage without extra hardware
pick filament and print orientation for structural rigidity of stacked storage bins

gridfinity.objective: Design a gridfinity-compatible bin with tool-shaped cutouts (e.g. for screwdrivers, pliers, etc.) sized to fit measured tools, 3D printed to snap into a standard gridfinity baseplate.

capabilities.reason: cutouts must be traced/measured from actual tools and modeled with correct clearance so tools sit snugly
gridfinity bins are built parametrically to match the grid unit spec and baseplate dimensions
material and print orientation choice affects durability of thin cutout walls holding tools

ledger.objective: A mobile/web app called "Ledger" that tracks a user's stock portfolio, letting them log holdings/transactions and see live prices, gains/losses, and performance over time.

capabilities.reason: need a normalized schema for holdings, transactions, and price history
need an authenticated API for users to manage their portfolio data
need to pull live/historical stock prices from an external market data API
need a web frontend to display portfolio, charts, and transactions
if shipping as a mobile app, need a native iOS client

dryer.objective: A wall-mounted bathroom device that blows warm air onto a user's body after showering to dry them off without a towel.

capabilities.reason: must size a blower and heating element to dry a body in reasonable time
device combines mains power and a heating element in a wet bathroom environment
enclosure must survive direct shower spray and humidity
housing, vents and duct geometry need to be modeled before fabrication
control logic for fan/heater sequencing, timers and button input
must isolate and size mains-derived power rails for heater and blower alongside any low-voltage control electronics

verstappen.objective: Create a short 3D animated clip of Max Verstappen's Formula 1 car racing on a track, modeled and rendered in Blender.

capabilities.reason: design the head's structural panels and shell to measured servo/mechanism dimensions
design the transformation linkage so panels move and lock without binding
drive multiple servos to sequence the transformation and pan/tilt motion
detect a person entering the camera's view in real time
convert noisy person detections into smooth pan/tilt actuator targets
coordinate camera input, tracking logic and servo outputs on a microcontroller
supply multiple servos and vision compute without brownouts
